Review: square look Unisex Salon Experience

I recently visited a square look unisex salon for the first time, and I must say, it was a refreshing experience that shattered any preconceived notions I had about gender-specific salons. In an era where individuality and inclusivity are celebrated, unisex salons offer the perfect blend of services tailored for everyone, regardless of gender.

Ambiance and Atmosphere
Upon entering the salon, I was greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere. The decor was modern yet cozy, with soft lighting and comfortable seating that made me feel at ease. The space was well-organized and clean, with a palpable sense of professionalism that gave me confidence in the services I was about to receive.

Staff and Service
The staff at the salon were incredibly skilled and approachable. They took the time to listen to my preferences and offered personalized recommendations based on my hair type and face shape. I appreciated that the stylists were equally adept at handling both masculine and feminine styles, which highlighted their versatility. Throughout the appointment, they engaged in friendly conversation, creating a relaxed environment that made the experience enjoyable.

Range of Services
The range of services offered was impressive. From haircuts and color treatments to facials and manicures, the unisex salon catered to a variety of beauty needs. I opted for a haircut and some highlights. My stylist provided a detailed consultation, ensuring that my desires and expectations were met with precision. The final results were stunning—my hair looked vibrant and healthier than ever!

Inclusivity and Comfort
One of the standout features of this unisex salon was its commitment to inclusivity. The environment felt welcoming to people of all identities, ensuring that everyone could feel comfortable and respected. The presence of unisex services also eliminated the awkwardness sometimes felt in gender-specific salons, where customers might feel stereotyped or out of place.

Pricing and Value
The pricing was reasonable, with a variety of packages that could accommodate different budgets. Given the high-quality services and the professionalism of the staff, I felt that I received great value for my money. The salon also offered special promotions, making it accessible for regular visits.

Final Thoughts
Overall, my experience at the unisex salon was nothing short of excellent. The combination of skilled stylists, a welcoming atmosphere, and a diverse range of services makes it a fantastic option for anyone looking to pamper themselves. I left feeling rejuvenated and confident, with a hairstyle that perfectly reflected my personality. I wholeheartedly recommend this unisex salon to anyone seeking a top-notch beauty experience that embraces individuality. I will definitely be returning for my next appointment!

featured_reviews.name: Trusha Kahar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this salon. Initially, the owner quoted me higher prices for waxing, manicure, and pedicure services. However, when I checked the rate card inside, the actual prices were ₹100–₹150 lower per service. Despite this, I decided to proceed since I was in a hurry.
Unfortunately, things only got worse from there. While the waxing and eyebrows were manageable, the manicure and pedicure were extremely poorly done. During the manicure, my cuticles were cut so harshly that I started bleeding and had to hold cotton for quite some time to stop it. The pedicure was even worse—my heel cracks were left untreated, nail shapes were uneven despite clearly requesting short and round nails, and overall the work was very unprofessional.
To make matters worse, the massage was done with an overly oily cream that had hair stuck in it, which was extremely unhygienic.
When I shared my feedback, I expected at least some acknowledgment or concern. Instead, the owner became defensive and claimed that certain things were “complimentary,” including a basic scrub and even nail polish—which, surprisingly, wasn’t even included in their so-called package. The nail polish they did offer was dried out, and I eventually asked them to skip it altogether.
Overall, a very unpleasant and unprofessional experience. I would not recommend this salon if you’re looking for hygiene, transparency, or quality service.
